newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's KDD plans record capital spending in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Japan's KDD plans record capital spending in 97/98.

text.p: Japan's international carrier Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co said on Friday that it planned a record high 104 billion yen in capital spending for the fiscal year starting from April 1.
Construction of an undersea optic fibre cable looping around Japan's main islands will absorb 30.4 billion yen of that, the company said.
The cable, announced late last year as part of its move into the domestic long-distance phone market, will be completed by March 1999.
KDD also said capital spending in the current year ending on March 31 would exceed its initial plan and reach 77 billion yen because of higher infrastructure investments.
KDD originally planned to spend 63 billion yen in 1996/97.
